note: Original SVG hardware illustrations, not product photographs or hardware-test evidence. Manufacturer photographs and CAD were consulted for shape/control layout. Distinct example screens use Google Dino Advance, Pokémon Ruby / Sapphire, DOOM GBA and Celeste Classic 2 game-frame composites, not device captures. The hero reserves an initially empty layer for separately credited SeedSigner splash and Home software previews during page animation. Frame aspect ratios are preserved. The regular display clips only the black padding around the square Celeste gameplay area; other screens use letterboxing. Approximate perspective and comparative sizes, not exact scale.
